program.name: Missouri Working Family Tax Credit (WFTC)
program.description:
Missouri's Working Family Tax Credit (WFTC) helps working people lower their Missouri taxes. You may qualify if you get the federal Earned Income Tax Credit (EITC). For tax year 2024 and forward, the WFTC is generally 20% of your federal EITC. Your credit cannot be more than the Missouri income tax you still owe.

The WFTC is nonrefundable. It can lower your Missouri income tax to zero. You will not get any unused credit as cash, and you cannot use it in a future tax year.

Some tax rules may change your result. You may not qualify if you file married filing separately. You may also not qualify if someone claims you as a dependent. Rental or other investment income may affect your eligibility. Other Missouri tax credits may lower your WFTC amount.

Select "File Now" to see your options for filing your Missouri income tax return and claim the WFTC.
